name: Udupi Sri Krishna Matha
description: The Sri Krishna Matha in Udupi is a famous Krishna temple where devotees view the deity through the Kanakana Kindi, a small window with nine holes. The temple's free meals (anna dasoha) serve thousands every day.
history: The temple was founded in the 13th century by the philosopher-saint Madhvacharya. It is managed in rotation by the Ashta Mathas (eight monasteries), with the handover ceremony called Paryaya held every two years.
how_to_reach: Udupi is 400 km from Bengaluru and 60 km from Mangaluru airport. It is a major station on the Konkan Railway; overnight buses run from Bengaluru.
tips: Men may need to remove shirts for some rituals. Combine with Malpe Beach (6 km) and St. Mary's Island.
summary_kn: ಮಧ್ವಾಚಾರ್ಯರು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದ ಉಡುಪಿ ಶ್ರೀ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಮಠ ಕನಕನ ಕಿಂಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ನದಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: मध्वाचार्य द्वारा स्थापित उडुपी श्री कृष्ण मठ कनकना किंडी और निःशुल्क अन्नदान के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Murudeshwar
description: Murudeshwar is a seaside temple town with the world's second-tallest Shiva statue (123 feet) and a 20-storey Raja Gopura, set on Kanduka Hill surrounded on three sides by the Arabian Sea.
history: According to legend, a piece of the Atma Linga that Ravana carried from Kailash fell here, giving the temple its sanctity. The modern statue and gopura were built in the 2000s.
how_to_reach: Murudeshwar has its own Konkan Railway station. It is 160 km from Mangaluru and 500 km from Bengaluru; overnight buses are available.
tips: Scuba diving at Netrani Island runs from October to May and needs advance booking.
summary_kn: ಅರಬ್ಬೀ ಸಮುದ್ರ ತೀರದ ಮುರುಡೇಶ್ವರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ವದ ಎರಡನೇ ಅತಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ಶಿವನ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು 20 ಅಂತಸ್ತಿನ ರಾಜಗೋಪುರವಿದೆ.
summary_hi: अरब सागर के किनारे मुरुदेश्वर में दुनिया की दूसरी सबसे ऊँची शिव प्रतिमा और 20 मंज़िला राजगोपुरम है।

name: Dharmasthala
description: Dharmasthala, on the banks of the Netravati river, is famed for the Sri Manjunatha Swamy Temple, where a Shiva temple is run by a Jain family and worship follows Vaishnava traditions - a symbol of religious harmony.
history: The temple has been administered for over 800 years by the Heggade family. The village is also known for a 39-foot Bahubali statue installed in 1982 and its daily free meals for thousands of pilgrims.
how_to_reach: Dharmasthala is 300 km from Bengaluru and 75 km from Mangaluru. KSRTC runs direct buses; Mangaluru is the nearest airport and railhead.
tips: Men must wear dhoti or remove shirts inside the sanctum; dress conservatively.
summary_kn: ನೇತ್ರಾವತಿ ತೀರದ ಧರ್ಮಸ್ಥಳದ ಶ್ರೀ ಮಂಜುನಾಥ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಸರ್ವಧರ್ಮ ಸಮನ್ವಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ನದಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: नेत्रावती तट पर धर्मस्थल का श्री मंजुनाथ मंदिर धार्मिक सद्भाव और अन्नदान के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Kukke Subramanya
description: Kukke Subramanya is a revered temple of Lord Subramanya, worshipped here as the lord of serpents, set in the forests of the Western Ghats at the base of Kumara Parvatha peak.
history: The temple is mentioned in the Skanda Purana. Devotees perform the Sarpa Samskara and Ashlesha Bali rituals here to remove sarpa dosha.
how_to_reach: Kukke is 280 km from Bengaluru. Subrahmanya Road station (12 km) is on the Bengaluru - Mangaluru line; overnight buses are frequent.
tips: Book special sevas online in advance during the Champa Shashti festival.
summary_kn: ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಘಟ್ಟಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುವ ಕುಕ್ಕೆ ಸುಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣ್ಯ ನಾಗಾರಾಧನೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ.
summary_hi: पश्चिमी घाटों के बीच स्थित कुक्के सुब्रमण्य नाग पूजा के लिए प्रसिद्ध तीर्थ है।

name: Sringeri
description: Sringeri on the Tunga river is the seat of the first matha established by Adi Shankaracharya. The Sharadamba Temple and the zodiac-pillared Vidyashankara Temple are its highlights.
history: Adi Shankaracharya founded the Sringeri Sharada Peetham in the 8th century. The Vidyashankara Temple, built in 1338 with Vijayanagara patronage, has twelve pillars aligned so that sunlight falls on the pillar of the current zodiac month.
how_to_reach: Sringeri is 330 km from Bengaluru and 90 km from Chikkamagaluru. Direct KSRTC buses run from Bengaluru and Mangaluru.
tips: Free meals are served at the matha. Pair with Horanadu (60 km) and Agumbe (25 km).
summary_kn: ತುಂಗಾ ತೀರದ ಶೃಂಗೇರಿ ಆದಿ ಶಂಕರಾಚಾರ್ಯರು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದ ಶಾರದಾ ಪೀಠ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾಶಂಕರ ದೇವಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: तुंगा नदी के किनारे श्रृंगेरी आदि शंकराचार्य द्वारा स्थापित शारदा पीठ और विद्याशंकर मंदिर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Horanadu
description: Horanadu is home to the Sri Annapoorneshwari Temple, set amid lush Western Ghats forests on the banks of the Bhadra river. Every visitor is offered free food, true to the goddess of nourishment.
history: The temple is believed to have been consecrated by sage Agastya. The present golden idol of Annapoorneshwari was installed in 1973 during the temple's renovation.
how_to_reach: Horanadu is 100 km from Chikkamagaluru and 330 km from Bengaluru. Buses go via Kalasa; roads are winding ghat sections.
tips: The ghat roads are narrow; avoid night driving in the monsoon.
summary_kn: ಭದ್ರಾ ನದಿ ತೀರದ ಹೊರನಾಡು ಶ್ರೀ ಅನ್ನಪೂರ್ಣೇಶ್ವರಿ ದೇವಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ; ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಉಚಿತ ಅನ್ನಪ್ರಸಾದ ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary_hi: भद्रा नदी के किनारे होरानाडु श्री अन्नपूर्णेश्वरी मंदिर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है; यहाँ सबको निःशुल्क भोजन मिलता है।

name: Kollur Mookambika
description: The Kollur Mookambika Temple at the foot of Kodachadri hills is one of the seven Muktisthala pilgrimage sites of coastal Karnataka, dedicated to Goddess Mookambika.
history: Legend says Adi Shankaracharya meditated at Kodachadri and installed the deity here. The temple is especially popular with devotees from Kerala and Karnataka during Navaratri.
how_to_reach: Kollur is 80 km from Udupi; Byndoor/Mookambika Road station (28 km) is on the Konkan Railway. Direct buses run from Bengaluru (440 km).
tips: Jeeps to Kodachadri start from Kollur - book early in the morning.
summary_kn: ಕೊಡಚಾದ್ರಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಪ್ಪಲಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕೊಲ್ಲೂರು ಮೂಕಾಂಬಿಕಾ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ.
summary_hi: कोडाचाद्री पहाड़ियों की तलहटी में स्थित कोल्लूर मूकाम्बिका मंदिर एक प्रमुख शक्ति तीर्थ है।

name: Chamundi Hills
description: Chamundi Hills rises 1,060 m above Mysuru and is crowned by the Chamundeshwari Temple, the family deity of the Wadiyars. A giant monolithic Nandi statue sits along the 1,000-step path to the top.
history: The goddess Chamundeshwari is believed to have slain the demon Mahishasura, after whom Mysuru is named. The 4.9 m tall Nandi was carved in 1659 under Dodda Devaraja Wadiyar.
how_to_reach: The hill is 13 km from Mysuru city centre; city buses run from the Mysuru bus stand, or climb the steps from the base.
tips: Climb the steps at sunrise and take a bus down. Weekends and Fridays are crowded.
summary_kn: ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಚಾಮುಂಡಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಚಾಮುಂಡೇಶ್ವರಿ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಮತ್ತು ಬೃಹತ್ ಏಕಶಿಲಾ ನಂದಿ ಇವೆ.
summary_hi: मैसूरु की चामुंडी पहाड़ी पर चामुंडेश्वरी मंदिर और विशाल एकाश्म नंदी प्रतिमा है।

name: Melukote
description: Melukote is a hilltop temple town with the Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple and the Yoga Narasimha Temple perched on a rocky hill, along with stepped ponds that are popular film locations.
history: The Vaishnava saint Ramanujacharya lived in Melukote for about 12 years in the 12th century. The town is famous for the Vairamudi festival when the deity is adorned with a diamond crown.
how_to_reach: Melukote is 150 km from Bengaluru and 50 km from Mysuru, via Pandavapura.
tips: Try the famous puliyogare (tamarind rice) prasada sold near the temple.
summary_kn: ರಾಮಾನುಜಾಚಾರ್ಯರು ನೆಲೆಸಿದ್ದ ಮೇಲುಕೋಟೆ ಚೆಲುವನಾರಾಯಣ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಮತ್ತು ಪುಳಿಯೋಗರೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: रामानुजाचार्य से जुड़ा मेलुकोटे चेलुवनारायण स्वामी मंदिर और पुलियोगरे प्रसाद के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Namdroling Monastery (Bylakuppe)
description: Namdroling Monastery, the Golden Temple at Bylakuppe, is one of the largest teaching centres of Tibetan Buddhism in the world. Its prayer hall holds 18-metre gilded statues of Buddha, Padmasambhava and Amitayus.
history: Bylakuppe was set up as a Tibetan refugee settlement in 1961. The monastery was founded in 1963 by Penor Rinpoche and today houses thousands of monks and nuns.
how_to_reach: Bylakuppe is 220 km from Bengaluru and 85 km from Mysuru, next to Kushalnagar on the way to Coorg.
tips: Visit around 6 PM to hear the monks' evening prayers. Keep voices low inside the halls.
summary_kn: ಬೈಲುಕುಪ್ಪೆಯ ಸ್ವರ್ಣ ಮಂದಿರ ಎಂದೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾದ ನಾಮ್‌ಡ್ರೋಲಿಂಗ್ ಮಠ ಟಿಬೆಟನ್ ಬೌದ್ಧ ಧರ್ಮದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕೇಂದ್ರ.
summary_hi: बायलाकुप्पे का स्वर्ण मंदिर कहलाने वाला नामड्रोलिंग मठ तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्म का बड़ा केंद्र है।
